definition: Participants or clinical population do not meet the review eligibility criteria
boundary_note: Includes mixed eligible/ineligible populations when results for the eligible subgroup are not available; setting alone is classified separately.

definition: The intervention does not match the eligible intervention
boundary_note: Includes intervention composition, route, dose, timing, or co-interventions when those features define the intervention mismatch.

definition: The comparator or comparison does not match the eligible comparison
boundary_note: Includes absent eligible controls and comparisons between ineligible variants of an intervention.

definition: Required outcomes are absent or ineligible
boundary_note: Use insufficient_or_unavailable_data instead when the outcome was measured but cannot be separated or obtained.
Includes non-randomized, observational, single-arm, pseudo-randomized, post-hoc, and otherwise ineligible analytic designs.

definition: The care or recruitment setting is ineligible
boundary_note: Use population when the problem is who was enrolled rather than where or when care was delivered.

definition: Eligibility fails because of treatment timing
column5: Intervention timing can also receive intervention when Cochrane describes it as part of the intervention mismatch.

definition: The allocation or analysis unit is ineligible or produces non-independent data
boundary_note: Kept separate from study_design because the underlying trial may otherwise use an eligible randomized design.

definition: The record or trial status makes the evidence ineligible
boundary_note: Includes protocols, registrations without eligible results, unpublished or withdrawn trials, retractions, and duplicate/secondary reports of included studies.

definition: Eligibility cannot be established or eligible results cannot be separated or obtained
boundary_note: Includes unavailable reports, missing subgroup results, and analyses that cannot isolate the eligible contrast.

definition: Cochrane states only that inclusion criteria were not met without identifying which criterion failed
boundary_note: Do not infer a more specific category from the chatbot description or study title.
